versions.changelog:
ppt-craft-editable 0.1.5

- Improved multi-stage workflow for PPT content extraction, deck building, and HTML editor preview.
- Enhanced support for PDF-to-editable PPT conversion using multimodal extraction and HTML review.
- Updated scripting for preview, shell injection, and review processes to streamline user confirmation steps.
- Polished user-driven retouch and visualization logic for phase transitions and gatekeeping actions.
- Internal script and automation adjustments for more robust and consistent file outputs and workflow stages.

**Added PDF-powered editable PPTX extraction (Phase D).**

- 新增 Phase D 分支：支持用户上传 PDF 版 PPT，自动区分矢量文字与图片页，用多模态模型抽取页面结构和文本内容。
- 增加 PDF extraction、结构审核、无字背景生成及 HTML 可编辑预览等完整工作流，最终一键导出原生可编辑 PPTX。
- 新增多项 Phase D 专用脚本和 HTML 壳（如 extraction_to_deck.py、pdf_extract_multimodal.py 等）。
- README 与 SKILL.md 文档大幅更新，详细说明 PDF 流程、交互门禁和各阶段输入输出规范。
- 若用户对话触发特定标记或上传 PDF，自动切换至对应流程，无需重复追问。
- 其它编辑器及预览壳、参考文档等基础设施完善与补充。

ppt-craft-editable v0.1.3

- Initial public release of end-to-end PPT workflow (self-contained skill).
- Adds comprehensive multi-phase (A, C/only) architecture with strict stage and HTML "gates".
- Provides scripts and assets for environment check, candidate/preview/review HTML shells, and PPTX generation.
- Enables Phase C (editable PPT) generation, complete with HTML-based text editing and deck JSON serialization.
- Includes documentation, workflow breakdowns, and rules for agent behavior and robust multi-stage environment validation.

No changes detected in this version.

- No file or documentation changes from previous version.
- Skill logic and user workflow remains the same.

- 修订 Phase C 实现方式：Phase C 需以 Phase A 的定稿图作为视觉参考，重新生成“带装饰、留白文字区”的无字背景图，避免将 Phase A 图片直接擦字处理。
- 明确指出 Phase C 生成的背景并非精确定稿图去字，背景可能与 Phase A 定稿有细微差异，强调可编辑文字始终以真实 TextBox 形式落地。
- 对 Phase C-only 路径的产物要求进行细化，明确需生成“重新生成的无字背景+可编辑文字预览”。
- 删除 Phase C 可能直接采用 Phase A 成品图抠除文字内容的描述，确保流程合规。
- 对整体描述和流程文字进行缩减、优化，提升逻辑清晰度和一致性。

Initial public release — combines end-to-end PPT creation with native editable and retouch capabilities.

- Automates environment checks and dependency installation on first use, requiring no user intervention unless critical issues are found.
- Enforces key workflow stages with mandatory browser-based HTML previews and reviews.
- Default workflow walks users from requirements intake, visual style preview, image-based design, to optional phase for editable PPTX generation.
- Directly supports user requests for "editable only" workflows, bypassing image-based steps as needed.
- Includes robust disk space, dependency, and environment validation with clear user guidance for any issues.
- Integrates multi-phase, conversation-first and image-first process for high-fidelity PPTX delivery, with easy entry into either phase.
